summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding reported issues with the analytics dashboard, specifically concerning time filters (working hours) and network selection. The user provided a screenshot and URL for the production traffic report.

Troubleshooting revealed that the working hour filter was malfunctioning, preventing date range adjustments. After testing across different browsers, it was determined that the feature was broken/malfunctioning on the dashboard side.

The conversation concluded with follow-up questions regarding who should handle a specific filter implementation for another party.
decisions: The working hour filter issue on the analytics dashboard is confirmed to be a bug requiring attention.
action_items: Follow up on implementing or assigning ownership of a specific filter feature (for 'Вознюку').
